Recast continuing operations: 2025 net sales $19,945 million (2024: $19,281 million) and segment profit $3,507 million - Building Automation $7,367 million, Process Automation and Technology $6,437 million, Industrial Automation $6,111 million; 2025 organic sales growth 2% (Building Automation 8%, Industrial Automation (1)%); Q1 2026 net sales $4,823 million and segment profit $944 million.
